provenance.transport: Real HTTP: public/index.php under PHP's own web server on 127.0.0.1. Member calls are form-encoded as the iOS app encodes them, with every selector the build sends; console calls as the console encodes them, with its secret.
provenance.declared_orchestration: Members, sessions, switches and the operator rows (administrator, moderator, support viewer) are written by the generator. Every event is published, edited, marked and withdrawn through the console routes; corrections, joins, hides and the report are the members' own HTTP calls. A Dates restriction and the section switch are toggled on stored rows for two assertions and restored. The approving edit waits for the next second so that "last decided first" is not a tie.
provenance.normalized_clock_fields: Every integer inside the capture's own run window becomes 1790000000 (Monday 2026-09-21 14:13:20 UTC), and one inside that window plus seven days (the next manual check) 1790604800, and one inside that window plus an intake's two retention spans that constant plus the span; an event start or end, which the generator sets at a fixed offset from the start of the run, becomes the same offset from 1790000000, and its Europe/Budapest wall-time spellings those of that instant; the re-researched event's times are whole minutes (its page states minutes) and become the same whole minutes after 1790000000.
provenance.normalized_identifier_fields: act_, xev_, cor_, thr_, aud_, rck_, src_, msg_, xin_, rru_ and rso_ identifiers are mapped to stable ones in first-seen order
